subtitle: Split bills in any currency
description:
Fairpot makes splitting shared costs quick and fair.

Add an expense, enter the receipts, choose how many people are sharing, and Fairpot shows exactly what each person owes — in the currency you paid and in your home currency.

• ANY CURRENCY — pesos, dollars, euros, yen and 160+ more. Rates update daily and are locked in when you save, so old expenses never change. Paid with a card at a different rate? Type your own.

• SHARE IN ONE TAP — send a clear summary by Messages, WhatsApp or email, with your payment details (e-Transfer, GCash, PayPal, Wise or any other) and receipt photos if you like.

• RECEIPT PHOTOS — snap the receipt and keep it with the expense.

• SUMMARIES — totals by category, month and year, all in your home currency.

• PRIVATE BY DESIGN — no account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device in a real database, and you can save a backup to Files or iCloud Drive whenever you want.

• IPHONE AND IPAD — on iPad, Fairpot uses the full width of the screen.

Fairpot is free. A full illustrated User Guide and Quick Start are available from the Help button in the app.
promotionalText: Split a dinner, a trip or a round of drinks in seconds — in any currency, with totals in yours. No account, no ads, and everything stays on your device.

review.notes:
Fairpot needs no account, login, credentials or sample files.

1. Screen recording: attached to our reply in App Review. Recorded on a physical iPhone running the latest iOS, starting with launching the app. Fairpot has no account registration or login, no user-generated content and no paid content or in-app purchases.

2. Purpose and audience: Fairpot is a free expense splitter for friends, families and travel groups. When one person pays a shared bill (a dinner, groceries, a trip), Fairpot divides it evenly and shows what each person owes, in the currency paid and in the user's home currency. The user can then send everyone a clear summary with their payment details. It solves the "who owes what, in which currency" problem without accounts, ads or data collection; all data stays on the device.

3. Instructions: On first launch, tick "I have read and agree" and tap Accept on the Terms of Use. On the New tab, enter a description, the number of people and the currency, add receipts (category, amount, optional photo) and tap Save. Share sends the split through the iOS share sheet. History lists saved expenses (Details, Share, Edit, Delete). Summary shows totals and holds the settings: Help (online User Guide), home currency, payment methods, receipt categories, backup and restore, and the Terms of Use.

4. External services: Only one. A public exchange-rate table from ExchangeRate-API (open.er-api.com) is downloaded once a day, with no API key and no personal data. There is no authentication service, payment processor, AI service, analytics or advertising. Data is stored on the device in a local SQLite database. The Help button opens our User Guide at cuberoot-systems.com.

5. Regional differences: None. The app works the same in all regions. The home currency defaults to Canadian dollars and can be changed in Summary; numbers and dates follow the device settings.

6. Regulated industry or third-party material: Not applicable. Fairpot is a calculator: it does not process, hold or transfer money and gives no financial advice. Payment details are plain text the user types to include in their own messages. All content and artwork are original.
